profile.summary: sheplu is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Node.js version management and CI/CD pipelines. Their contributions focus on maintaining compatibility across Node.js versions (16.x-21.x) in Express.js projects, debugging JavaScript runtime issues in CI environments, and managing project documentation. While their work is primarily indirect (through CI testing and dependency updates rather than direct code changes), they demonstrate strong skills in tooling, version control, and system reliability. The developer shows particular proficiency in GitHub Actions workflows and dependency upgrades, with evidence of debugging JavaScript-related CI failures and organizing project documentation.
